<!--
A dissertation carries a contents and a list for each kind of float unless it
says otherwise, which is the other way round from the rest of apaquarto.

Three things at once here. There is a figure, so a list of figures is set
without being asked for. There is no table, so no list of tables is set: a
heading over an empty page helps nobody, and the Graduate School's own
template says "if no tables, delete this page". And there is an illustration
but list-of-illustrations is false, so that list is left out and the contents
does not name it either.

The figure's caption is long enough to turn over in the list of figures, and
the line it turns onto begins under the first word of the caption, not under
the number. typst set the first line a space further in than the second.
The words stop half an inch short of the right margin on every line, so the
title turns over before it reaches the column of page numbers, and the
number stands at the margin on the line it turns onto.
-->
